scientific_question: Does the zero-mean detector-integrable component of the deployment-visible BOS residual retain the full observable affine-field information demonstrated by v179, or did v184 fail because detector-potential compression itself destroys the field-compatible inverse rather than because its scalar-ray Jacobi lift was too crude?
role: post-open mechanism-capacity diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames; it is not predictor training, fresh generalization, or a resource benchmark
physical_hypothesis: For each reported geometry, the same linear zero-mean detector-potential integration applied to both the current centered vector observation and every frozen affine-basis response defines a gauge-consistent potential-domain measurement system. If that system remains full rank, an exact potential-domain affine pseudoinverse should recover the field-compatible coordinates even though v184's scalar-ray Jacobi lift failed.
physical_distinction: v185 does not retune v184's scalar ray, Jacobi diagonal, line search, detector differences, or physical K1. It removes the mismatched scalar-ray lift entirely and asks a distinct information-preservation question by applying one identical geometry-only Hodge integration operator to data and reduced vector forward responses before inversion.

potential_affine_primary.detector_coordinates_and_mask: exactly inherit v184's reported-geometry 24x24 detector nodes, valid-ray mask, physical camera identity, and lexicographic node order
potential_affine_primary.gradient_matrix: exactly inherit v184's immediate physical-coordinate central difference or unique one-sided difference rule; omit a derivative component only when neither immediate neighbor exists
potential_affine_primary.potential_operator: for each camera, the linear map L_g sends any vector block b to the unique zero-mean phi solving min_phi ||G phi-b_valid||_2 using the exact KKT system [[G^T G,1],[1^T,0]]

potential_affine_primary.formal_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd with LAPACK gesdd; retain singular values s_i >= s_0*sqrt(float64 epsilon)
potential_affine_primary.independent_inverse: a separately assembled potential system solved with LAPACK gesvd under the identical fixed relative threshold

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, parent, graph, KKT, inverse, rank, stationarity, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v185 inconclusive.

If potential-affine pseudoinverse K0 and K1 both fail either sensor arm, conclude FAIL_POTENTIAL_AFFINE_OBSERVABILITY_V185 and close the zero-mean detector-potential representation for this affine inverse.
If K0 fails but K1 passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_POTENTIAL_AFFINE_K1_CAPACITY_V185; this only authorizes a separately frozen compact approximation diagnostic.
If K0 passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_POTENTIAL_AFFINE_K0_CAPACITY_V185 and prefer K0 as the cheaper capacity reference regardless of K1.
If either potential-coordinate CGLS1 arm also passes both sensor arms, it blocks any claim that the full potential pseudoinverse is necessary.
No v185 outcome is a learned algorithm, deployable exact-call reduction, wall/RSS result, fresh generalization, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
